goal: Extract the duplicated inline five-field reservation snapshot comparison in coordinator.ts's advance() and submitReview() into a shared pure compareReservationSnapshot function, and extract advance()'s full review-ready validity check into a pure reservationStillValid function, with no change to which requests are accepted or rejected.

acceptance.assertion: advance() still reuses a matching Review reservation and still releases a stale one when any one of the five snapshot fields (record_revision, workspace_revision, intent_revision, intent_content_hash, diff_hash) changes, using the new reservationStillValid/compareReservationSnapshot functions with identical accept/reject outcomes to before the extraction.
Both the Pi and Claude host adapters observe the same reservation-validity outcomes through their real ports after the extraction; no host-specific divergence is introduced.
submitReview()'s stale-snapshot rejection, including its lifecycle/artifact_state conditions that stay outside the shared compareReservationSnapshot function, is unchanged for both hosts.
